mentions.name: Solitaire & card games website
mentions.description: A website offering solitaire and other card games that works really well, created as an alternative to existing card game sites that are full of bugs and ads. The game is nearly complete, with a few more weeks needed to polish gameplay and fix rendering quirks before being put online for easy access.
mentions.problem: Existing solitaire/card game websites are full of bugs, full of ads, or both.
mentions.audience: The author themself, for playing card games when bored (built as a personal-use site)
mentions.source_excerpt: Website with solitaire/card games. There are so many sites, but all of them are either full of bugs, full of ads or both. So long time ago I've decided to write a site for myself that works really well, and then I shifted my attention to other projects.
